title: s25 far-band census lands: the smooth ln-t law bends at ~2e6G with a t-squared drift; the f64 trap channel is adjudicated degraded, not a signal
body:
s25 (5 rows, t/G = 2e6 .. 5e7, t to 1.5e18, all 32 threads, ~6 h) extends the defect census two more decades past the 1e6G data limit. The dps-40 split-quadrature channel (authoritative) gives integer-quantized M on all five rows:

  t/G       M
  2e6   -452220768
  5e6   -475565520
  1e7   -493803232
  2e7   -514240832
  5e7   -557909504

s26 fits the full 33-row set (t/G = 1 .. 5e7, ~7.7 decades).

  -  the 28-row pre-census ln-t law (A = -2.525484e7, B = +5.234850e8, max residual 7719 on (1G, 1e6G]) holds at 2e6G to within ~3e4, then the measured M falls below the extrapolation with a drift that TURNS ON around 1e6G-2e6G and runs t-squared-like over the far rows (per-doubling drift ratios 4.1 / 4.0 / 6.3 -- the t^2 value is exactly 4; a single power fit over the whole range gives p = 2.23 +/- 0.03, K = 2.0e-10, fit rms 0.27 in log -- the turn-on, not a pure power over the range).
  -  the t^2/G far-bias kernel family (the s12/s20 candidate list) is the leading match for the drift shape; this is the first NON-LOG input to the far-structure question (the s19/s19b smooth-data deconvolution limit is exactly what this input removes).
  -  the v3 GATED clause constants (A = -25256007, B = 523513775) on the near band t/G < 2.2 are UNCHANGED (max residual 6063): the drift starts far above the clause domain, no re-gate.

Channel audit (the census rows are the first with a large trap divergence):

  -  the f64 u-trap cross-check diff grows SMOOTHLY with t: ~1e8 at 1e11 (s16) -> ~5e13 at 1.5e18 (s25), monotonically across the lineage. Adjudicated as the discretization limit of the 2M-point f64 grid on u in [ln G, ln 1e30] (cancellation headroom loss near the in-band log singularity as t approaches the 1e30 edge), NOT a signal.
  -  all 5 census rows pass the exact f64 sum-accounting check: recorded M = fl(eps + logzeta - lm - la - re - I_far), i.e. M is exactly determined by the dps-40 channels and the integer quantization is the channel structure, not noise.
  -  OUTSTANDING verification: dps-80 I_far recompute at 2e7G and 5e7G (in flight at the time of writing) + logzeta dps-40 vs dps-60 cross. If the recheck fails, the drift is an engine artifact and the t^2 family is killed (see the pathway doc, section 4).

Next: s27 deconvolution -- forward-simulate parametric far-count biases through the engine's own kernel to locate, inside (G, 1e30], what produces the measured t^2 drift.

Also in this entry's scope (meta): the chronicle itself migrated at this point -- the root DISCOVERY_LOG.md is frozen and the log now lives in docs/discovery/ (one JSON per entry + generated interactive DISCOVERY.html; add-entry flow in docs/discovery/README.md). This entry 97 is the first hand-written post-migration entry. The PATHWAY-TO-A-SOLUTION document (docs/PATHWAY-TO-A-SOLUTION.md) is the new single source of truth for program STATE; see that document for the re-chart.
